rows.grounds: Compound: śrī (auspicious/Śrī), śrīśa (lord-of-Śrī), dvādaśa-akṣara (twelve-syllabled); refers to two twelve-syllabled mantras; Vaiṣṇava context per transmission brief.
Indeclinable adverb indicating sequence in ritual narration.
Indeclinable compound prati+aham indicating daily repetition.
From root arc (to worship/honor); describes performance of worship in ritual sequence.
